newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S TRUTH PROBE CALLS ON BUSINESS, LABOUR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S TRUTH PROBE CALLS ON BUSINESS, LABOUR.

text.p: The statutory Truth and Reconciliation Commission said on Thursday that it would ask key South African business and labour leaders to attend a public hearing on the role of business under apartheid.
The hearing, set down for November 11-13, would cover any human rights violations from 1960 to 1994, the truth commission said in a statement.
"The commission will be approaching key roleplayers in business and labour to ask them for submissions," it added. Details on the hearing will be issued after these consultations.

The commission, trying to heal the country's divided past by seeking confessions to political crimes and forgiveness from victims, has also held hearings with the media, churches and doctors to hear their version of how apartheid affected them.
